header.title: Drawer
header.description: Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen over a dimmed backdrop. Like the modal, it blocks the rest of the page and keeps focus inside until it closes. Use it for filters, item details, forms that accompany the page, or navigation on small screens. With `placement` top or bottom it works as a sheet.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and open the panel to see the result. `placement` changes apply the next time it opens. In `showHandle`, `auto` shows the grabber only on top and bottom.

texts.title: Order details
texts.subtitle: Order #1042
texts.body: The order is being prepared and will ship within the next 24 hours.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Control the panel with `open` and `onOpenChange`. `title` and `subtitle` build the header, `children` the body and `footer` the action bar. It slides in from the right by default. Pass a translated `closeLabel`: the × button is announced as "Close" by default.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: `placement` picks the edge: `right` (default), `left`, `top` or `bottom`. On top and bottom the panel spans the full width and shows a grabber to signal it's a sheet.

texts.title: Placement
texts.body: The panel enters from the chosen edge and leaves the same way when it closes.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` sets the width on the sides and the height on top and bottom: `sm` (20rem), `md` (24rem, default), `lg` (32rem), `xl` (40rem) and `full`. It never exceeds the viewport width, and on top or bottom the maximum height is 92% of the viewport.

texts.title: Size
texts.body: The size comes from the --gem-drawer-extent variable, which each size class redefines.

customSize.title: Custom size
customSize.description: Besides the presets, `size` accepts a number (pixels) or any CSS value like `"18rem"` or `"40vw"`. In that case the panel gets the `gem-drawer--custom` class and the value is set inline on `--gem-drawer-extent`.

texts.title: Custom size
texts.body: Useful when the content needs a width that doesn't match any preset.

bottomSheet.title: Bottom sheet
bottomSheet.description: `Sheet` is an alias of `Drawer`, meant for top or bottom sheets. With `placement="bottom"` the grabber shows up on its own; hide it with `showHandle={false}`. It works well for action menus on small screens.

compound.title: Compound sections
compound.description: If every child is `Drawer.Header`, `Drawer.Body` or `Drawer.Footer`, the panel uses them as-is instead of building the sections from props. The × button is still added to the header. In this mode the panel doesn't take its name from the title: connect it with `headingId` and `aria-labelledby`.

texts.title: Workspace settings
texts.subtitle: Personal plan
texts.body: Compound sections make the markup explicit when the body is more than a paragraph.
texts.hint: Drawer.Body accepts className and any div attribute.

form.title: Form
form.description: On open, focus goes to the first focusable element other than the ×, here the first field. The save button lives in the footer, outside the `<form>`, and connects through the `form` attribute, so native validation still works.

navigation.title: Navigation menu
navigation.description: A left panel with `size="sm"` works as a menu on small screens. Mark the current section with `aria-current` and close the panel when an option is chosen.

persistent.title: No automatic dismissal
persistent.description: With `closeOnBackdrop={false}`, `closeOnEscape={false}` and `showClose={false}` the panel only closes from a footer action. It keeps what was typed from being lost by an accidental backdrop click.

tailwind.title: Floating panel
tailwind.subtitle: Detached from the edge with a blurred backdrop
tailwind.body: classNames adds classes to each part. With Tailwind's backdrop: variant you can also style the backdrop.

cva.title: Panel with variants
cva.body: The wrapper applies the cva variants to className and forwards the rest of the props.

css.title: Brand panel
css.subtitle: Tokens redefined in a class
css.body: The class changes the width with --gem-drawer-extent and redefines the color and radius tokens only inside this panel.

header.title: Drawer API
header.description: API reference for the Drawer React component: props, sections, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or its subpath. The sections are available as `Drawer.Header`, `Drawer.Body` and `Drawer.Footer`, and also as standalone exports. `isDrawerSizeToken` tells whether a `size` value is a preset.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <dialog> (DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>, except title and open) and forwards them to the element, as well as ref. classNames adds classes to each part: root, handle, header, title, subtitle, extra, body, footer and close.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.dialog: It's a native <dialog> opened with showModal(): the browser puts it in the top layer and makes the rest of the page inert. It has aria-modal="true".
a11y.name: With title, the panel takes its name from the title (aria-labelledby). With compound sections, connect the headingId of Drawer.Header with aria-labelledby. Without a title, pass aria-label.
a11y.focus: On open, focus goes to initialFocusRef or, if missing, to the first focusable element other than the × button.
a11y.trap: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle only through the panel's elements.
a11y.restore: On close, focus returns to the element that had it before opening, usually the button that opened the panel.
a11y.scroll: While open, it locks page scroll with overflow: hidden on <body>.
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the panel appears and disappears without animation.
a11y.labels: The × button is named "Close" by default. Pass a translated closeLabel.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.placement: Edge the panel enters from and its off-screen position before opening.
rules.custom: Applied when `size` is a number or a CSS value. The variable is set inline.
rules.radius: Radius on the free edge from `radius`.
rules.entered: Applied once the panel has entered. Moves it into place and shows the backdrop.
rules.handle: Grabber of top and bottom sheets. Receives `classNames.handle`.
rules.handleEnd: Grabber at the end of the panel, with `placement="top"`.
rules.headerSolo: Header without subtitle. No styles of its own; it's a hook.
rules.heading: Wrapper of the title and subtitle.
rules.title: Title (`<h2>`). Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.subtitle: Subtitle. Receives `classNames.subtitle`.
rules.body: Body with its own scroll. Receives `classNames.body`.
rules.footer: Footer with the actions, aligned to the end. Receives `classNames.footer`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Drawer has a single variable of its own; the other colors and radii come from gem-system tokens, which you can redefine in a class (see Style changes). The size classes set `--gem-drawer-extent`, so to change it use a selector like `.gem-drawer.my-class` or pass the value in `size`.

items.--gem-drawer-extent: Width on the sides and height on top and bottom. Never exceeds the viewport width or 92% of its height.

items.--gem-color-border: Panel border, header and footer dividers, and grabber color.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Radius with `radius="sm"` and of the × button.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring of the panel and the × button.
items.--gem-space-2: Gap between footer and header actions.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the Drawer and its sections.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: Also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<dialog>`. `Sheet` takes the same props.

items.placement: Edge it enters from. If it changes while open, it applies on the next open.
items.title: Header title. Also the accessible name.
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header, before the × button.
items.header: Free content inside the header. Combines with `title`, `subtitle` and `extra`.
items.size: Width on the sides or height on top and bottom. A number is pixels and a string is a CSS value.
items.radius: Radius on the free edge using gem-system tokens.
items.showClose: Shows the × button in the header.
items.showHandle: Shows the sheet grabber. Defaults to `true` with `placement` `top` or `bottom`.
items.initialFocusRef: Element that receives focus on open.
items.container: Element where the panel is mounted (portal).
items.onOpenChange: Runs when the panel requests to open or close (Escape, backdrop, × button).

header.title: Drawer.Header
header.description: Header for compound sections. Also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<header>`.

items.title: Title (`<h2>`).
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header.
items.close: Custom close control. The panel adds its × button after it.
items.children: Free content between the title and `extra`.

sections.title: Drawer.Body and Drawer.Footer
sections.description: They have no props of their own: they accept the HTML attributes of a `<div>` and a `<footer>`, including `className` and `children`.
